textNotes.text: Just like most things it's RNG. I seem to have luck on my side this time. The shadow sword took me 8 months. I'm happy this time it was less😂 I have also put in over 30 hrs. since launch...lol I appreciate you. I just wish the raid respawned and all enemies reset. 😔

textNotes.text: I'm really hoping there is a pesky 1% drop that hasn't been found yet. Maybe a amulet or ring hmmmm =) since they didn't add one for Scorn Wilderness it seems.  It would make it feel like a true raid in my opinion. textNotes.author: @fenderslasher
textNotes.text:
Beat the entire raid in adamant gear and farmed all the Kuldra drops and skipped the entire end game materials.

You guys really dont need to worry about what gear is best. All the numbers are so close to each other, there isnt a single enemy where even the top weapon would kill in even a single hit less than what you were already using from the last expansion. Its all an illusion, the devs are te…

textNotes.author: @ricardoricardoricardoricardo
textNotes.text:
@rainbowGZUS7  you played when the zone was bugged of after the patch? Mind you that processing the base material was 3:1 instead of 1:1 that it is now.
Anyway, I skipped rune and went straight to dragon gear since farming the boss was easier.

textNotes.author: @davidgarza4592
textNotes.text:
Dragonwilds vet here with over 185 hours in my main world, plus around 4-5k hours on OSRS. Unfortunately, they missed pretty hard with this update. The raid is too easy, there are too many bugs, and the progression didn't quite make sense, you could get full dragon well before ever gathering enough resources to make full rune.

That said, I'm still enjoying it a lot, and it's only a few minor twea…
